body: One question can pull a conversation much deeper than either person expected it to go. When Mercury conjoins Pluto, thought and power fuse, making it difficult to stay interested in the polite version of a story when you suspect something more important is underneath it. This is strong astrology for research, difficult conversations, negotiations, and finally naming the thing everyone has been circling. Ask the one question that actually changes your strategy, and let the silence do the heavy lifting. Gather the data you need to move forward, then step back before investigation turns into an interrogation.
